image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet, perched on a green blade of grass. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying a uniform brown color with a distinct row of circular eyespots (ocelli) along the wing margins. The body is fuzzy and dark, and long, slender antennae extend from the head.
